name: Ecreate Product Health Check – Find Missing WooCommerce Product Data
author: Ecreate Infotech

sections.description:
Most WooCommerce stores have products with something missing: a product image that was never uploaded, a product still sitting in “Uncategorized”, a variation with no price, or a missing weight that breaks your shipping rates. These problems cost sales, and they are almost impossible to find by opening products one at a time.

Ecreate Product Health Check is a product audit for your shop. It scans the whole catalogue and lists every product with missing data, so you know what to fix first.

Ecreate Product Health Check scans your whole catalog and shows you exactly which products need attention and why. Click a problem to see the products it affects, then open each one to fix it.

What it checks

  • No product image
  • Product image without alt text
  • No price, including variable products where a variation has no price
  • No short description
  • No description
  • Only in the default “Uncategorized” category
  • No SKU
  • No weight, for physical products only (virtual and external products are skipped)
  • No product tags

Features

  • One-click scan of all products, in batches, with a progress bar. Works with large catalogs.
  • Store health score: the share of products with no issues.
  • A card for each check with the number of products affected.
  • Product list for each problem with image, SKU, status and a direct Edit link.
  • Export the full report to CSV to share with your team or a developer.
  • The report stays up to date: products are re-checked whenever they are saved, and removed when they are trashed.
  • Turn off checks that do not apply to your store, such as weight if you do not ship products.
  • Read only: the plugin never changes your products.
  • Checks draft, pending, private and scheduled products as well as published ones.
  • Compatible with WooCommerce order storage (HPOS) and the cart and checkout blocks.

Want the problems fixed for you?

If you would rather not fix hundreds of products by hand, we can add missing images, descriptions, SKUs, weights and categories in bulk, clean up imported product data, or build any custom WooCommerce feature you need. Please contact us.
sections.installation:
1. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  2. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins > Add New Plugin and search for “Ecreate Product Health Check”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Go to Products > Health Check, or click Open on the Plugins page.
  5. Click “Scan products”.
sections.faq:
How do I find WooCommerce products with no image?

Run a scan. The missing image check lists every product without a featured image, and you can open each one straight from the list.

How do I find products with a missing price, SKU or category?

The same scan covers prices, SKUs, weights, descriptions, short descriptions, categories and variations without a price. Each check can be switched off if it does not apply to your shop.

Can I export the list of products that need fixing?

Yes. Any list can be exported as a CSV, which is handy for handing the work to someone else or for importing corrections in bulk.

Does the plugin change my products?

No. It only reads your products and shows a report. You fix each product yourself in the normal product editor.

How long does a scan take?

Products are checked 25 at a time, so large catalogs can be scanned without the page timing out. The time depends on the number of products and your hosting. Keep the page open until the scan finishes.

Do I need to scan again after fixing a product?

No. Every time a product is saved, it is checked again and the report is updated. Scan again only if products were changed in a way that bypasses WooCommerce, such as direct database edits.

Why is a variable product listed as having no price?

At least one of its variations has no price. Customers cannot buy that variation until it has one.

Why are some products not checked for weight?

Virtual, external and grouped products are not shipped, so they do not need a weight. A downloadable product is only skipped when it is also marked as virtual.

Can I turn off a check?

Yes. Use “Which checks to show” at the bottom of the page. The report updates straight away, without a new scan.

Does it slow down my store?

No. The plugin only runs in the admin area. It adds nothing to your store’s front end.

Does it need WooCommerce?

Yes. It checks WooCommerce products, and shows a notice if WooCommerce is not active.
